data.rationale: The proposed steps match the true procedure in the same order (city, Special Events & Experiences, event, ticket count, Book Now or time option, Reserve Now), but there is no explicit date parameter; it uses a broader "event" parameter that covers it only loosely, and "Click Book Now or time slot" is somewhat ambiguous for automation.
